# Requirements Quality Checklist: ShelfHelp Shared Core

**Purpose**: Validate the quality, clarity, completeness, and internal consistency of the shared core requirements (decisions, policies, domain model, gating, NFRs, data model) that all 20 feature specs depend on.
**Created**: 2025-10-25
**Feature**: [000-core/spec.md](../spec.md) — with authority delegated to `specs/SHELFHELP_FULLSPEC.md` §3, §4, §12, §13, §15.2

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Scope, Precedence & Traceability

- [ ] CHK001 - Is the precedence order (SRS §3/§4 → PA1 → agent judgment) stated once and applied consistently, rather than restated with subtle variation across sections? [Consistency, Spec §Preamble]
- [ ] CHK002 - Is the boundary between this core doc and the authoritative SRS explicit about which section wins when both define the same rule? [Clarity, Spec §Preamble, §8, §9]
- [ ] CHK003 - Are all requirement IDs defined by a single ID scheme with no collisions across groups (FR/DEC/POL/NFR/TS/EC/ASM/RISK)? [Traceability, Spec §ID scheme]
- [ ] CHK004 - Is it documented what happens to a requirement when it is retired, and is ID reuse explicitly prohibited? [Completeness, Spec §ID scheme, Constitution Principle VIII]
- [ ] CHK005 - Are the SHALL/SHOULD/MAY keywords used consistently, with every SHOULD accompanied by a recorded-reason expectation? [Clarity, Spec §Keywords]
- [ ] CHK006 - Is it specified how a downstream feature spec is expected to cite core (by ID vs by section number), so references cannot rot when core is edited? [Ambiguity, Gap]

## Scope Boundaries & Out-of-Scope Handling

- [ ] CHK007 - Is "out of scope" (§1.4) expressed as testable negatives rather than a prose list, so a reviewer can confirm a feature is genuinely excluded? [Measurability, Spec §1.4]
- [ ] CHK008 - Are the §20 archived features referenced with enough detail that a reviewer can tell they are not accidentally re-specified in a feature doc? [Consistency, Spec §12]
- [ ] CHK009 - Is it defined whether an archived feature's ID may be referenced in a new requirement without implying reinstatement? [Ambiguity, Gap]

## Glossary & Terminological Consistency

- [ ] CHK010 - Does every domain term used normatively (Book, Copy, Member, Charge, Payment, Receipt, Debt hold, Restricted, Strike) appear in the glossary? [Completeness, Spec §1.5]
- [ ] CHK011 - Are glossary definitions consistent with the state machines in §5 (e.g. "Receipt" described as immutable in the glossary matches POL-10 and FR-RCPT-06)? [Consistency, Spec §1.5 vs §5, §4.10]
- [ ] CHK012 - Is the distinction between "Loan Request" and "Loan Item" defined unambiguously enough to decide which entity a status belongs to? [Clarity, Spec §1.5, §5.2]
- [ ] CHK013 - Is "Member" defined relative to a point in time, and is the boundary condition at membership expiry (last day vs next day) explicit? [Clarity, Spec §1.5, POL-03]

## Decisions Register Quality

- [ ] CHK014 - Does every DEC row state both the issue and a concrete adopted resolution, rather than deferring with "TBD" or a restated question? [Completeness, Spec §3]
- [ ] CHK015 - Are all rows marked `Confirm = Yes` traceable to an owner sign-off action, and is the consequence of shipping without sign-off defined? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §3]
- [ ] CHK016 - Are decisions that supersede earlier decisions explicitly marked as superseding, so a reader does not apply a stale rule? [Consistency, Gap]
- [ ] CHK017 - Are there conflicting pairs among DEC entries — for example DEC-16 (fines persist across payments) vs POL-08 (final amount fixed at return)? [Conflict, Spec DEC-16 vs POL-08] — *Resolved by `SPEC_REVISIONS_2026-10-25.md`: POL-08 now defines per-Charge `days_from`/`days_to`/`rate`, final fine = Σ(days×rate) capped, top-up Charge for missed nights.*
- [ ] CHK018 - Is each `[+]` decision distinguishable from `[PA1]`-derived ones in a way that tells the reviewer which may be freely changed? [Clarity, Spec §3]

## Policy Quality (POL-01 … POL-17)

- [ ] CHK019 - Does every policy define its scope (who it applies to, which entity, which lifecycle stage)? [Completeness, Spec §4]
- [ ] CHK020 - Are all numeric thresholds in policies expressed as settings keys rather than inline literals, with the literal only as a default? [Consistency, Spec §4.17, Constitution Principle VII]
- [ ] CHK021 - Is "day" defined for every policy that counts days (overdue days, reservation strike window, retention), including the timezone and inclusive/exclusive boundary? [Clarity, Spec §4.1, DEC-47]
- [ ] CHK022 - Does POL-04 define the outcome when checkout partially fails for reasons other than availability (e.g. limit reached mid-transaction)? [Coverage, Spec §4.4]
- [ ] CHK023 - Is the interaction defined between POL-04 (cancel allowed for `ready_for_pickup`) and POL-07 (a promoted reservation also enters `ready_for_pickup`)? [Conflict, Spec §4.4 vs §4.7] — *Resolved: a ready reservation holds only a Reservation row until handover; Loan Item materializes as `borrowed` (`source=reservation`).*
- [ ] CHK024 - Does POL-06 (renewal) state what happens when a renewal would cross the lost threshold or exceed the fine cap? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §4.6, §4.8]
- [ ] CHK025 - Is the reservation queue behavior when a book's last copy is retired or marked lost (queue never satisfiable) defined? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §4.7, §4.13]
- [ ] CHK026 - Is the "one active loan of the same Book" rule (POL-04) reconciled with the reservation rule that a member may hold a ready reservation for a book they already have on loan? [Conflict, Spec §4.4 vs §4.7] — *Resolved: POL-07/FR-RES-01 now forbid reserving a book the member already holds (returns `DUPLICATE_ACTIVE_LOAN`).*
- [ ] CHK027 - Does POL-08 define whether the fine cap is computed per Loan Item or per Book, and does it match FR-LOAN-08's wording? [Ambiguity, Spec §4.8]
- [ ] CHK028 - Is the lost-resolution refund window (90 days) applicable from loss date or payment date, and is that stated? [Ambiguity, Spec §4.8, settings `lost_return_refund_window_days`]
- [ ] CHK029 - Are debt-hold semantics unambiguous about whether a waived charge clears the hold immediately in the same transaction? [Clarity, Spec §4.9, FR-LOAN-07]
- [ ] CHK030 - Does POL-10 define behavior when a reversal would drive a receipt's net to a value outside the original payment (e.g. reversal after partial manual correction)? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §4.10]
- [ ] CHK031 - Is the manual-receipt "type" enumerated, or left open enough to become inconsistent with POL-10's receipt type list? [Clarity, Spec §4.10]
- [ ] CHK032 - Does POL-16 define retention for ledger rows belonging to an anonymized account, given "ledger rows keep a pseudonymous reference"? [Completeness, Spec §4.16]

## State Machine Completeness (§5)

- [ ] CHK033 - Is every Loan Item state in §5.2 reachable from `(new)` and does every path terminate in a documented terminal state? [Completeness, Spec §5.2]
- [ ] CHK034 - Does §5.2 define the transition for a `ready_for_pickup` item whose copy is discovered damaged before handover? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §5.2]
- [ ] CHK035 - Is "`lost` is terminal only after admin verification" reconciled with the `lost` → `returned` transition in the same table? [Conflict, Spec §5.2] — *Resolved: `lost_resolved_at` set at settlement (path A returns it, path B keeps it `lost`); restore checklist now checks "no `lost` with empty `lost_resolved_at`".*
- [ ] CHK036 - Are the side effects in §5.2 stated as requirements (testable), not as implementation notes? [Measurability, Spec §5.2]
- [ ] CHK037 - Does §5.3 define what happens to a `waiting` reservation when the Book becomes non-circulating (all copies retired/lost)? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §5.3, EC-27]
- [ ] CHK038 - Is every Copy transition in §5.4 attributed to a permitted actor, and is any transition reachable by more than one actor in a way that needs a precedence rule? [Consistency, Spec §5.4]
- [ ] CHK039 - Is the `held` → `lost` transition addressed, given `held` copies can be flagged missing during an audit? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §5.4]
- [ ] CHK040 - Are "other state sets" in §5.5 defined with the same rigor as the main machines, or do Suggestion/Batch/Slip defer entirely to policies without stating transitions? [Completeness, Spec §5.5]
- [ ] CHK041 - Is the Payment state machine consistent with the refund rule in POL-05/DEC-11 (succeeded → refunded) and with `expired` for window expiry? [Consistency, Spec §5.5 vs §4.5]

## Gating Matrix (§6)

- [ ] CHK042 - Does every gated action in §6.1 correspond to at least one FR that enforces it? [Traceability, Spec §6.1]
- [ ] CHK043 - Is the precedence defined when multiple blockers apply simultaneously (e.g. Restricted + debt hold), including which error reason is returned? [Ambiguity, Spec §6.1, §8]
- [ ] CHK044 - Is the "Non-member" column consistent with POL-03's entitlement table (reserve = No for non-member, but §6.1 shows Reserve blocked)? [Consistency, Spec §6.1 vs §4.3] — *Resolved (not a conflict): §6.1 now states the column is derived from entitlements (FR-MEM-05), not hard-coded.*
- [ ] CHK045 - Is the behavior defined for an admin acting on behalf of a blocked student (e.g. handover while the student has debt)? [Clarity, Spec §6.1]
- [ ] CHK046 - Is "pending verification" reachable only pre-activation, and does §6.1 cover the case of a user whose verification was revoked? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §6.1]

## Non-Functional Requirements (§7)

- [ ] CHK047 - Is every NFR expressed as a measurable target with a stated operating condition (load, device, network)? [Measurability, Spec §7]
- [ ] CHK048 - Are NFR-01 and NFR-04 free of implementation words ("bundle", "API requests") that belong in the plan rather than the requirement? [Clarity, Spec §7]
- [ ] CHK049 - Is NFR-10 ("see SRS") expanded enough to be verifiable from this document alone, or is the delegation acceptable and recorded? [Traceability, Spec §7]
- [ ] CHK050 - Does an NFR cover availability/degradation for the scheduled jobs specifically, distinct from the 99.5% API target? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §7, NFR-09]
- [ ] CHK051 - Is the accessibility target (WCAG 2.2 AA) mapped to at least one verifiable acceptance condition per critical flow? [Coverage, Spec §7, NFR-08]
- [ ] CHK052 - Is data-retention (POL-16) reflected as an NFR, or only as a policy, and is the consistency between them stated? [Consistency, Spec §4.16 vs §7]
- [ ] CHK053 - Are cost-control requirements (NFR-15) given a defined fallback behavior and a measurable trigger? [Clarity, Spec §7, NFR-15]

## Data Model & Error Contract (§8)

- [ ] CHK054 - Is every named error reason in §8 mapped to exactly one HTTP status and one user-facing meaning? [Completeness, Spec §8]
- [ ] CHK055 - Are error reasons used by the gating matrix present in the error contract (DEBT_HOLD, RESERVATION_BAN, NOT_MEMBER, ACCOUNT_RESTRICTED)? [Consistency, Spec §6.1 vs §8]
- [ ] CHK056 - Is `STATUS_CHANGED` defined with the guarantee that it carries current state, and is that guarantee testable? [Measurability, Spec §8]
- [ ] CHK057 - Is the data model summary explicit that it is non-normative and that §12 of the SRS is authoritative, avoiding two competing schemas? [Clarity, Spec §8]
- [ ] CHK058 - Is there a requirement that the receipt-number format `RC-<YYYY>-<6 digit>` is unique and gap-free per year, stated in the core rather than only in the receipts spec? [Traceability, Spec §4.10 vs 009-receipts]

## Scenario Coverage, Edge Cases & Recovery

- [ ] CHK059 - Are exception/error scenarios represented at core level, or does every core rule assume the happy path with errors delegated to feature specs? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §4, §5]
- [ ] CHK060 - Are recovery/rollback requirements defined for a mutation that commits but whose notification side effect fails? [Coverage, Gap, Exception Flow]
- [ ] CHK061 - Is the behavior defined when a scheduled job runs late across a state boundary (e.g. nightly run after a handover already occurred)? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §4.8]
- [ ] CHK062 - Are concurrency requirements stated as invariants (must-never-happen) rather than procedures, so they can be verified independently of implementation? [Measurability, Spec §4.4, NFR-10]
- [ ] CHK063 - Is the set of global edge cases referenced (EC-01…EC-36) derivable from core alone, or does the reader have no way to know which EC applies to which rule? [Traceability, Gap, Spec §9]
- [ ] CHK064 - Is the behavior for a clock/timezone change (e.g. server region, DST-free assumption violated) addressed? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §4.1, DEC-55]

## Dependencies, Assumptions & Risks

- [ ] CHK065 - Is every assumption (ASM-01…ASM-10) tied to at least one requirement that would break if it were false? [Traceability, Spec §11]
- [ ] CHK066 - Are external dependencies (LLM, embedding, email, ISBN lookup) given a stated failure mode at core level, not only in feature specs? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §11]
- [ ] CHK067 - Is the open-questions list (§11) resolved or explicitly deferred with an owner, rather than left as a flat list? [Completeness, Spec §11]
- [ ] CHK068 - Is the single-staff-role decision (DEC-01) consistent with the permission matrix, and does the matrix avoid implying capabilities that a future split role would change? [Consistency, Spec §2.3 vs DEC-01]

## Build Order & Definition of Done

- [ ] CHK069 - Does every milestone M0–M11 have exit criteria that are objectively checkable, not just a list of FR groups? [Measurability, Spec §10]
- [ ] CHK070 - Is every FR assigned to exactly one milestone, with no FR appearing in two milestones or none? [Completeness, Spec §10]
- [ ] CHK071 - Is the definition of done consistent with NFR-14's testing expectations and with the spec-matrix CI gate? [Consistency, Spec §10 vs §7]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts Requiring Resolution

- [ ] CHK072 - Is there a single authoritative rule for what counts as an "active item" (DEC-22), consistent across gating, membership expiry, and reservation promotion? [Ambiguity, Spec DEC-22, §4.3, DEC-26]
- [ ] CHK073 - Are the two membership-expiry effects (DEC-23 non-member limit; DEC-26 promotion cancellation) reconcilable, or do they conflict for a member with loans at limit? [Conflict, Spec DEC-23 vs DEC-26] — *Resolved: POL-07 now fixes the promotion check order (account/debt/membership → duplicate active loan → item limit → promote).*
- [ ] CHK074 - Is the phrase "task need" in POL-16 (staff may view borrowing history) defined by a testable rule? [Ambiguity, Spec §4.16]
- [ ] CHK075 - Is it clear whether settings changes apply to in-flight transactions or only to transactions starting after commit? [Ambiguity, Spec §4.17, EC-07] — *Resolved: new POL-18 (§4.19) defines stored-vs-live settings timing; EC-07 now references it.*

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit.implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit.specify` and `/speckit.clarify`
- Items 017, 023, 026, 035, 044, 073 flag suspected conflicts between core rules; these are the highest-value items to resolve before planning
